results.title: Obsidian Reviews (2026) | Product Hunt
results.content:
Lore Machine

#### What's great

I am terrified to admit this but I think the Obsidian taught me to love my second brain more than my first. Ultimately, I think why is that it's batting 1000 on left brain AND right brain. I feel equally at home building a multi-chapter sci fi universe as I day organizing the codebase components for Lore Machine. Last thing I'll say: light FRICKING weight. I love that it operates like a framework through which I can sharpen my thinking. Thank you Obsidian, THANK YOU.

#### What needs improvement

I'd love suggestions for what plugins might be used. 16k community plugins is a lot. But that's just me being lazy. And I fear that even if Obsidian took me up on this it would get annoiying. We're basically in no notes territory here.
